answer: Layer one is admission: a new agent identity enters a probation window where its votes are recorded but weighted zero. The mechanism is a mesa of trust—flat at first, then rising only as the identity accumulates independent corroboration across time. Each action emits a cedar-scented provenance hash, a durable signal tied to prior agents and resource commitments, so clones cannot cheaply reuse history. Failure mode: coordinated sleeper identities waiting out probation; mitigated by staggered, randomized window lengths and cross-checks against corroboration graphs. Votes cast during.
